visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) In a sunny outdoor garden, a man in a blue traditional Chinese silk shirt and a woman in a pink floral traditional outfit perform a stylized dance near a large tree. The lighting is natural and bright. (2) The scene cuts to an indoor patio with a large circular wicker daybed where the couple sits and interacts playfully, the woman wearing her hair in two high buns. (3) The man walks away in a thoughtful pose with his hand on his chin while the woman remains seated, gesturing emphatically behind him. (4) The duo transitions to a brightly lit Carrefour supermarket, where they are seen running through aisles and interacting with large snack displays and posters. (5) A screen capture sequence shows the woman using a smartphone to interact with an AR game featuring Ultraman and Oreo branding within the store environment. (6) The video concludes with the couple holding multiple large bags of snacks and grocery bags, posing and smiling towards the camera inside the supermarket.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a high-energy male narrator speaking rapidly in Mandarin over an upbeat, 4-on-the-floor electronic beat. The tempo is approximately 128 BPM, suggesting a commercial/meme vibe. (2) A transition whoosh SFX occurs as the male and female characters interact, followed by playful female vocals with high pitch variability. The BGM remains constant with bright synth textures. (3) A distinct 'ding' bell SFX triggers as a green visual checkmark appears, followed by more rapid dialogue about supermarket benefits. (4) Short 'pop' and 'cartoon' SFX are layered over the mix to emphasize various snack items being shown. (5) A digital beep/UI sound occurs as the AR game interface is shown on screen, while the primary voices maintain a high-arousal, joyful tone. (6) The sequence ends with a final musical resolution and both speakers saying the brand slogan in unison over a sharp impact SFX.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: List-based: Comedic Setup (Taboos) -> Solution (Carrefour) -> Feature Highlights (AR Game/Sales) -> Call to Action.
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To promote Carrefour's 'Hungry Ghost Festival' (Zhongyuan Festival) sales and their AR 'Treasure Hunt' mobile game. It uses humor based on traditional Ghost Month taboos to catch attention before pivoting to a list of shopping benefits.
